guide.title: Saju Terminology Guide
guide.subtitle: Basic terms to help you understand your Saju reading results

pillars.title: Four Pillars (四柱八字)
pillars.description: The Four Pillars (Year, Month, Day, Hour) represent the cosmic energies at the time of your birth. Each pillar consists of a Heavenly Stem (sky) and an Earthly Branch (earth), totaling 8 characters.

stem.title: Heavenly Stems (天干)
stem.description: Ten stems: Gab, Eul, Byeong, Jeong, Mu, Gi, Gyeong, Shin, Im, Gye. They represent heavenly energies, alternating between Yang and Yin.

branch.title: Earthly Branches (地支)
branch.description: Twelve branches: Ja, Chuk, In, Myo, Jin, Sa, O, Mi, Shin, Yu, Sul, Hae. They represent earthly energies and the 12 zodiac animals.

tenGods.title: Ten Gods (十星)
tenGods.description: Shows the meaning of other stems relative to the Day Master. Includes: Comparison & Rob Wealth (siblings), Output & Hurt Officer (expression), Wealth (money), Power & Officer (career), Resource & Seal (knowledge).

elements.title: Five Elements Analysis (五行)
elements.description: Analyzes the balance of five energies: Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water. The elements have relationships of generation and control, and balance is important.

wood.title: Wood (木) - Tree
wood.description: Growth, expansion, creativity, benevolence. Energy of Spring

fire.title: Fire (火) - Flame
fire.description: Passion, activity, honor, courtesy. Energy of Summer

earth.title: Earth (土) - Soil
earth.description: Mediation, trust, stability, tolerance. Energy of Season transitions

metal.title: Metal (金) - Iron
metal.description: Righteousness, determination, justice, integrity. Energy of Autumn

water.title: Water (水) - Liquid
water.description: Wisdom, flexibility, strategy, calmness. Energy of Winter

mutual.title: Mutual Generation (相生)
mutual.description: Wood→Fire→Earth→Metal→Water→Wood in order, helping each other. (Wood feeds Fire, Fire creates ash for Earth...)

strength.title: Strong/Weak Day Master (身强/身弱)
strength.description: Determines whether the Day Master's influence is strong or weak. Strong if many supporting energies (Comparison, Resource) exist in the chart, weak if few.

strong.title: Strong Day Master (身强)
strong.description: Many supporting energies (Comparison, Resource) make the Day Master strong.

weak.title: Weak Day Master (身弱)
weak.description: Few supporting energies make the Day Master weak.

twelveCycles.title: Twelve Life Cycles (十二運星)
twelveCycles.description: Shows what life cycle stage the Day Master is in for each pillar (Year, Month, Day, Hour). Like dividing human life into 12 stages.

daeun.title: Great Fortune Cycles (大運)
daeun.description: The flow of major fortunes that change every 10 years. Calculated forward or backward from the Month pillar at birth.

forward.title: Forward Movement (順行)
forward.description: Yang-year males and Yin-year females progress forward from the Month pillar to the next stems/branches.

backward.title: Backward Movement (逆行)
backward.description: Yang-year females and Yin-year males progress backward from the Month pillar to previous stems/branches.

importance.title: Importance of Great Fortune
importance.description: Different stems and branches influence each Great Fortune period, allowing prediction of life's turning points. Good fortunes bring opportunities, while difficult fortunes require caution.

shinsals.title: Special Stars (神殺)
shinsals.description: Lucky and unlucky stars that give special meaning to the Saju chart. They are not absolute and should be used as reference.

cheonul.title: Heavenly Noble (天乙貴人)
cheonul.description: Star of noble help. High chance of receiving help in difficulties or meeting benefactors.

yeokma.title: Travel Star (驛馬殺)
yeokma.description: Star of movement and change. Frequent travel, moving, job changes may occur.

dohwa.title: Peach Blossom (桃花殺)
dohwa.description: Star of romance and popularity. Good social skills and charm, but may need caution in romantic matters.

munchang.title: Literary Star (文昌貴人)
munchang.description: Star of academics and arts. Talent in studies or literature and arts.

hapchung.title: Combinations & Clashes (合沖刑破害)
hapchung.description: Analyzes harmonies and conflicts between stems or branches. Combinations mean harmony, while clashes mean change or conflict.

stemCombination.title: Stem Combinations (天干合)
stemCombination.description: Gab+Gi, Eul+Gyeong, Byeong+Shin, Jeong+Im, Mu+Gye combinations. They harmonize to transform into new elements.
stemCombination.example: Example: Gab-Gi combine to transform into Earth

branchCombination.title: Branch Combinations (地支合)
branchCombination.description: Ja+Chuk, In+Hae, Myo+Sul, Jin+Yu, Sa+Shin, O+Mi combinations. Called Six Combinations, they support each other.

tripleCombination.title: Triple Combinations (三合)
tripleCombination.description: Three branches combine to form one element. Very strong harmony.

branchClash.title: Branch Clashes (地支沖)
branchClash.description: Ja↔O, Chuk↔Mi, In↔Shin, Myo↔Yu, Jin↔Sul, Sa↔Hae combinations. Head-on conflicts representing change or discord.
branchClash.note: Clashes are not always negative; they can also become opportunities for change and development.

footer.note: This explanation is a brief summary of basic concepts in traditional Chinese astrology.
footer.consult: For more accurate and in-depth interpretation, please consult with a professional.
